newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia Yield Spreads-Widening on U.S. fear.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia Yield Spreads-Widening on U.S. fear.

text.p: Australian bond yield differentials widened sharply as the local market prepared itself for the worst case scenairo following today's U.S. data.
The February U.S. non-farm payrolls report later today is seen triggering the widely feared tightening in U.S. interest rates later this month when the Federal Open Market Committee meets.

Although the Reserve Bank of Australia is not expected to follow suit immediately, recent data suggesting that the economy is accelerating has made the market wary that any future tightening could be brought forward.
However, the local move is seen well overdone when looking at the benign inflation outlook, which was confirmed in this week's fourth quarter GDP.
